purpose: Independent CA/official-utility reference collection, not approved expected results.
common_assumptions: Synthetic adult individual cases only. No PAN, Aadhaar or personal documents.
Salary input is gross before standard deduction; all other salary adjustments explicitly screened absent.
All interest is gross before TDS. Eligible institution/type must be verified for 80TTA/80TTB.
No settlement/refund calculation is implied. Credits, filing dates, fees and interest require separate schedules.
ITA 1961 / FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27 only. No automatic TY 2026-27 reuse.
Pre-filled engineering expectations are review hypotheses, not approved golden output.
